verdict.rationale: n8n documents a first-party MCP Server Trigger node, and a probe confirms an official MCP server is documented at that node's page. That points to workflows being exposable to external MCP agents. However, the evidence gives only the node title and the probe note, with no detail on how workflows or connected app actions become callable tools. missing for 10: documented detail on tool exposure and configuration, how an external agent connects and authenticates, exposing connected app actions as tools, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can expose my workflows or connected app actions as MCP tools that an external agent can call
